blocks.x: Dorothy means gift from God so I had to be blessed with her coming into my life, helping me when I was out there, you know. She stood by me while I had to heal. But go ahead, sorry...
This is not, I don't see how you can use any of this. What you have to do is cut it out because this stuff is not presentable to a normal...
It's not missionary. I don’t know how to... I don't have an orthodox, I like the universal. But go ahead.
